en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint former New Zealand judge as CFA non-permanent judge
en.dek: The appointment of the retired New Zealand Supreme Court permanent judge will take effect after Legislative Council approval, raising the number of overseas non-permanent judges to six.
body: Chief Executive John Lee has accepted the recommendation of the Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission to appoint a former permanent judge of the New Zealand Supreme Court as a non-permanent judge of the Court of Final Appeal from another common law jurisdiction.

The appointment, which requires the approval of the Legislative Council under the Basic Law and the Hong Kong Court of Final Appeal Ordinance, will bring the number of such overseas non-permanent judges to six, the government said. The Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal, Andrew Cheung, welcomed the recommendation.

Lee said the appointee, who retired as a permanent judge of New Zealand’s highest court in April 2017, is highly regarded and will make a substantive contribution to the Court of Final Appeal. He noted that the list of overseas non-permanent judges will then comprise six distinguished jurists from the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand.
Lee added that the participation of such judges demonstrates confidence in Hong Kong’s judicial system and maintains links with other common law jurisdictions.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦 任命新西蘭前最高法院常任法官為終院非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德獲任命後，其他普通法適用地區非常任法官將增至六名，須立法會同意後生效。
body: 行政長官李家超接納司法人員推薦委員會的推薦，任命新西蘭最高法院前常任法官區諾德為終審法院其他普通法適用地區非常任法官。
政府表示，任命須根據《基本法》及《香港終審法院條例》徵得立法會同意後作出。終審法院首席法官張舉能歡迎有關推薦。任命後，其他普通法適用地區非常任法官數目將由五名增至六名。
李家超表示，區諾德於2017年4月退任新西蘭最高法院常任法官，地位崇高、聲譽卓著，深信對終審法院將有實質貢獻。他指名單將包括來自英國、澳洲及新西蘭的六位傑出法官。
李家超又說，這些海外法官的參與顯示外界對香港司法制度的高度信心，並維持與其他普通法適用地區的聯繫。
